newsitem.title: UK: Boots falls on renewed competition fears.
newsitem.headline: Boots falls on renewed competition fears.

text.p: Shares in pharmacist chain Boots Co Plc fell 13-1/2 pence to 629 pence following a newspaper report that Marks & Spencer was to join the price war for non-prescription drugs.

The Times newspaper said high street retailer Marks & Spencer wanted to start selling over-the-counter (OTC) drugs in January after supermarket chain ASDA Group has already begun selling its own brand OTC drugs at discount prices.
"That sort of announcement makes me more bearish longer term for Boots," said an analyst.
The Times report comes two weeks after Britain decided to take legal action to ban the Resale Price Maintenance on branded OTC drugs and increase competetion between pharmacies and retail chains.
